about: Limits used to decide whether a screenshot is a real picture or a blank one. They are judgements made for mstack, not rules of any platform. Change a value only with a reason, and change the date with it.

blank_top_colour_fraction.unit: share of sampled pixels that have the single most common colour
blank_top_colour_fraction.source: mstack default; a screen that is 99.8% one colour shows less than one short line of text

min_luma_stddev.unit: brightness levels on a 0 to 255 scale
min_luma_stddev.source: mstack default; below this the picture is one flat tone with noise

transparent_fraction.unit: share of sampled pixels with alpha 0

ignore_top_fraction.unit: share of the image height skipped at the top (status bar)
ignore_top_fraction.source: mstack default; the status bar is drawn by the system even when the app draws nothing

ignore_bottom_fraction.unit: share of the image height skipped at the bottom (home indicator)

min_side_px.source: mstack default; smaller than any device screen
